newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers shares boosted by asset swap.
newsitem.headline: De Beers shares boosted by asset swap.

text.p: De Beers shares moved sharply firmer on Thursday following an asset swap of some 410,000 of its shares overnight, dealers said.
The share was last quoted up 175 cents or 1.1 percent after over 654,000 shares worth 101.6 million rand -- the highest value traded on the exchange so far on the day -- changed hands in 89 deals.
The volume traded also accounted for more than a quarter of the 400 million rand turnover on the exchange before 1100 GMT.
"There was an asset swap which took place at the close of trade yesterday (Wednesday)," a dealer said.
Dealers said some 410,000 shares valued at about 63 million rand were involved in the swap.
The bellwether counter was also attracting interest after it announced earlier this week that earnings rose 37 percent in the year to December 31.
"There is still a lot of attraction for shares doing business outside of the country. There are also good results coming out of mining financials," another dealer added.
